original.question: Smt. Cruz ek ghar dhundh rahi hai jo uske ₹400,000 budget se upar na jaye. Usne ek property dekhi jiska bechne ki keemat ₹350,000 hai. Iske alawa, kharidne wale ko brokerage fee dena padta hai jo bechne ki keemat ka 5% hai, aur transfer fee bhi dena padta hai jo bechne ki keemat ka 12% hai. Ghar ki kul keemat Smt. Cruz ke budget se kitni zyada hai?
